penalties.authority: Registrar of Companies, Kolkata, Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA).
penalties.details: The MCA levied an aggregate penalty of Rs. 30,000/- on RPSG Sports Private Limited (RSPL), a subsidiary of RPSG Ventures Limited, and its officers in default, following RSPL’s suo motu approach to the MCA for rectification of certain inadvertent and non-material omissions in its Annual Return for the F.Y. 2024-25. The matter stands fully resolved.
